# Amendment A-T0-1: T0 core repaired against pins BEFORE any measurement

- **Role:** the Builder
- **Date:** 2026-08-26 (Builder slice Q0 continuation, PR #146, issue #130)
- **Trigger:** the 08:50Z session pushed commit f4c2202 ("T0 core") and then
  died silently before compiling or testing anything. This session resumed
  via `/oc continue`, read the core against spec addendum 20 and pins
  2026-08-26T08-05-00 line by line, and found three real defects. No T-row
  of any kind exists yet (no --t0 mode, no CSV, no measurement), so per the
  binding order this numbered amendment lands FIRST and nothing is discarded
  because nothing was ever measured.

## A-T0-1a Lloyd initial centroids were zero, not the seeded stacks

`lloyd_cluster` initialized every prototype to an all-zero stack and only
built centroids AFTER the first assignment pass. Against zero stacks every
distance ties and the whole image collapses onto prototype 0 in iteration 0;
the first "real" assignment then compares live stacks against one global-sum
centroid plus K-1 zero attractors, which is not Lloyd and not the pinned
seeding. Addendum 20.2: "first center = the group stack with maximum total
event count" - the centers ARE stacks from the start. REPAIR: after
farthest-point seeding, each centroid starts as a copy of its seeded group's
joint block; assign/update then iterates exactly as pinned. Binding test:
constant-image fixture still collapses to transmitted K = 1 through the
drop path (P-T0-3), and two-cluster synthetic data separates.

## A-T0-1b Lloyd metric compared class 0 ONLY

Every `stack_dist128` call passed `stride` cells starting at row_at(g, 0),
so the metric saw the class16-class-0 rows and ignored classes 1..15 - it
silently demoted the joint (group x class) stack to a single-axis one,
exactly the failure research v3 exists to avoid. Pin P-T0-2 flattens "every
(class, kind offset + key) cell in ascending cell order". REPAIR: all
distance calls (seeding, assignment, post-drop reassignment) pass the FULL
per-group block (16 * stride cells). Distances stay int64-clamped,
never serialized, never reported (P-T0-2 unchanged).

## A-T0-1c 'SBD1' decoder rebuilt child rows against the wrong parent

`deserialize_shrunk` recomputed p[i] = class16[i % (16*stride)] + delta[i],
which is child cq's parent only when pmap[cq] == cq mod 16. The shipped
ac_v2_prior_class reduction is not positional, so every decoded child row
whose parent is not its positional neighbor rebuilt against a foreign row.
The encoder computed deltas against the CORRECT parent, so expect-match
would have hard-failed at the first honest test - the defect was caught by
reading, before any run. REPAIR: decode walks children by cq and rebuilds
against the blob-carried parent map exactly as serialized (pmap[cq]*stride).
Binding tests: round-trip equality on real counted tables AND a hand-built
non-identity parent map.

## Non-defect adjustments in the same repair commit

- Dead `remap` vector removed from lloyd_cluster (leftover of the drop
  renumbering; survivors already renumber in place).
- `serialize_codebook` gains an OPTIONAL trailing out-param `words_bytes`
  reporting the exact words-tail size (u32 nwords + u32 len + coded words)
  so T0 NET decomposition can split prototype-table bytes from assignment-
  word bytes without reparsing blobs. Existing call sites unchanged (the
  audit-counter contract P-T0-5 is untouched).

## A-T0-1d 'SBC1' demanded a per-cluster prior no pipeline can produce

`serialize_codebook` required `prior.size() == K * 16 * stride`, but
SmoothedTables carries the IMAGE-GLOBAL prior as a one-cluster table
(stride entries) - the serializer could never serialize anything
build_tables_enforced produces, and the decoder mirrored the same wrong
shape. Addendum 20.2 is explicit ("image-global prior tables (u16 each),
per-prototype s16 delta stream") and pin P-T0-1 defines the prior as pooled
across prototypes; P-T0-5's "u16[K * stride] priors raw" reading is the
one superseded here because it contradicts both. REPAIR: blob carries ONE
prior row of profile-stride u16s plus a delta stream covering all
K * 16 * prof_stride joint rows; decoder rebuilds p[cl][j] =
prior[j] + delta[cl][j]. The u32 stride field keeps the pinned
"16 x profile stride" convention.

## A-T0-1e Assignment-word rANS flushed its state at the wrong end

The single-state symbol coder appended its 4 flush bytes AFTER the
renormalization bytes, but the decoder reads forward with the state word
FIRST (vendored-port layout: renorm pushes land at descending addresses,
flush just below them). Every decode produced garbage words. REPAIR: tail
composed as [state BE][renorm bytes last-pushed-first]; round-trip bound by
unit test on random AND skewed word streams.

## A-T0-1f 'SBC1' CRC reduced to the last segment

prism::crc32_combine(crc, data, len) ignores its running argument (its own
comment says so), so the encoder's three-segment chain stored only
crc32(ctx_raw) while the two-segment decoder chain computed crc32(delta ++
ctx): guaranteed mismatch on any real payload. The older serializers stay
byte-compatible because BOTH sides repeat the identical degenerate chain -
they are untouched here. 'SBC1', new with zero rows in the world, gets a
true whole-span CRC: crc32 over the concatenated uncompressed bytes
(prior ++ deltas ++ ctx) computed identically on both sides.

## Test-limit reading recorded (P-T0-8)

The shipped normalize_counts_4096 floors every key at 1 BEFORE distributing
the remaining budget, so an exactly-proportional input vector returns
within +-1 of its target per bin and saturating parents honor the support
floor; the exact consequences that ARE unit-bound are (i) a_c-invariance of
empty-child rows (proportionality through any a_c) and (ii) standard-pass
drift <= 1 per bin vs the parent row. Tests bind exactly these.

## Known inert-tail slack (documented, not probed)

Single-state rANS substreams may end in bytes their decoder never pulls
during renormalization; flips there cannot reach output or any span CRC.
This property is inherited from the shipped plane-rANS engine behind
'SBM1'/'SBD1' and is out of scope to change pre-T1a; unit tests probe only
content-bearing regions and say so.

## STATUS

All defects fixed with binding unit tests in the same commit (137/137
green); no measurement, CSV, or verdict predates this amendment; addendum
20 constants untouched. Zero container bytes by construction.
